title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Reissued Sale Notice Days
content:
Notice desk term for a notice of intent to sell mailed on a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case that already carries earlier notices of intent to sell.

**Rule.** Where the case already carries two or more notices of intent to sell, 10 days are added; where it carries exactly one, 7 days are added; where it carries none, no reissue days are added.

| Notices of intent to sell already on the case | Days added |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| exactly one | 7 |
| two or more | 10 |

## Points of judgement

- Every notice of intent to sell already recorded on the case is counted, whatever its stated date, including a notice whose period was too short.
- The notice being mailed is not counted among those the case already carries.
- Other notices on the case (a right-to-cure notice, a personal property notice) are not notices of intent to sell.
